faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does moncabinetcric ensure compliance with CICC regulations?
faq.a1: Our architecture strictly adheres to College record-keeping requirements: timestamped immutable user logs, Canadian data hosting, and strict segregation of staging and production data.
faq.q2: What is the difference between the commercial pipeline and the casework pipeline?
faq.a2: The commercial pipeline tracks prospects until retainer signature. Once converted, the client enters the regulatory pipeline (IRCC / MIFI) with distinct milestones, never skewing your sales analytics.
faq.q3: Are international clients automatically exempted from Canadian sales taxes?
faq.a3: Yes. Our tax engine automatically applies provincial rules (GST/PST/HST or international tax exemption) based on client residency, generating compliant invoices with manual override option.
faq.q4: Can I export an entire client file in case of an inspection or transfer?
faq.a4: Absolutely. In one click, you can generate a consolidated archive (merged PDF or ZIP) containing client history, notes, retainer agreements, and all uploaded proofs.

Auth.closed_essai-echu_body: This firm's trial period has come to an end. Your data is neither deleted nor altered: it remains stored and will be visible again once a subscription is taken out, which you can do below in a few minutes.
Auth.closed_paiement-en-souffrance_body: The latest payment for this subscription could not be collected and the grace period has run out. Your data is neither deleted nor altered. Update your payment method below: access reopens as soon as the charge goes through, with no action needed on our side.
Auth.closed_abonnement-termine_body: This firm's subscription has ended. This is not a suspension and nothing has been lost: your data remains stored, intact, and will be visible again as soon as a subscription is resumed — below, in a few minutes.
Auth.closed_ouvert_body: This firm's access is closed without any known reason applying. That is a fault on our side, not yours. Describe the situation below: the request reaches us immediately.
Auth.securityNote: Your credentials are never shared with a third party. Sessions expire automatically.
Auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Use the “Email link” tab.
Auth.helpPlaceholder: Describe what is blocking you. Your name, your firm and the state of your access are attached automatically — no need to repeat them.
Auth.helpSent: Request sent. The operator has it and will reply to your usual address. Your data stays intact in the meantime.
Auth.helpAlready: A request is already pending for your firm. No need to send another: that one is not lost.
Auth.helpError: Sending failed. Try again in a moment.
Auth.memberSuspendedBody: The owner of this firm has suspended your access. Your files and your work are kept — nothing has been deleted. Speak to them to learn why and to have your access reopened.
Auth.memberRevokedBody: The owner of this firm has revoked your access. Your work remains attached to the firm and has not been deleted, but you can no longer sign in. Speak to them if you believe this is a mistake.
